name: Javelin of Lightning

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Lightning Bolt Throw
powers.text: Throw it at a target within 120 ft: it becomes a bolt, a 5-ft line to the target (Dex DC 13, 4d6 Lightning, half on a success); the target takes the javelin's damage + 4d6 Lightning on a hit (once per dawn).

summary: Once a day, throw it as a bolt of lightning: a 120-ft line (Dex DC 13, 4d6 Lightning) and 4d6 extra to the target.
text: Say the command word as you throw this magic javelin and it becomes a streak of lightning, a 5-foot-wide line running from you to a target up to 120 feet away. Creatures along the line, apart from you and your target, make a Dexterity saving throw against DC 13; each takes 4d6 Lightning damage if it fails, or half as much if it succeeds. On reaching the target the bolt is a javelin again; make a ranged weapon attack, and a hit deals the javelin's normal damage plus 4d6 Lightning damage. After that the lightning is spent until the next dawn, though the javelin still works as a magic weapon.
